units.source_text: 在这远离尘世的山乡，经常有水声助兴，使得音乐更加清澄悦耳。

en.t: In this mountain village far from the world, the sound of water often added to the pleasure, making the music even clearer and sweeter to the ear.

units.source_text: 那圣僧一般的八亲王，和这里只有一水之隔，顺风吹来管弦之音，历历可闻。

en.t: The saintly Eighth Prince was separated from this place only by a stream, and when the wind was favorable, the sound of pipes and strings came across distinctly.

units.source_text: 他便回想起当年旧事来，自言自语地说道：“这横笛吹得真好啊！

en.t: He then recalled old events from those years and murmured to himself, “That flute is beautifully played!
I wonder who is playing it.

units.source_text: 从前我曾经听过六条院源氏的笛，觉得他吹出的音非常富有情趣，娇媚可爱。

en.t: Long ago I once heard Genji of Rokujo-in play the flute, and I thought his tone was full of feeling, graceful, and charming.

units.source_text: 但现在这笛声过分澄澈，略有矫揉造作之感。

en.t: But this flute now is too clear and pure, with a slight sense of affectation.

units.source_text: 颇像致仕太政大臣一族之人的笛声。”

en.t: It sounds rather like the flute of someone from the retired Chancellor’s family.”
So many years have gone by!

units.source_text: 我屏除了这种游乐，度送若有若无的岁月，确已积下许多年分。

en.t: I have put aside such pleasures and passed years that seemed barely to exist; truly, many years have accumulated.

units.source_text: 此时就不免想起两位女公子的身世来，觉得非常可怜，难道就让她们终身笼闭在这山里么？

en.t: At this moment he could not help thinking of the two young ladies’ lives, and felt deep pity for them; was he to let them remain shut away in these mountains all their lives?

units.source_text: 他想：“反正要出嫁，不如许给了薰中将。

en.t: He thought, “If they must marry anyway, it would be better to promise one to Lieutenant General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 但恐此人无心于恋爱之事。

en.t: Yet I fear that he has no heart for matters of love.

units.source_text: 至于现世风的轻薄儿，怎么可做我的女婿呢？”

en.t: As for the frivolous young men of the present age, how could any of them become my son-in-law?”
Thinking this far, his heart fell into confusion.

units.source_text: 在他这沉闷寂寞的地方，短促的春夜也难挨到天亮。

en.t: In that dreary and lonely place of his, even a short spring night was hard to endure until dawn.

units.source_text: 而在匂皇子那欢乐的旅宿中，醉眠一觉，早已天明，只嫌春夜太短呢。

en.t: But at Prince Niou’s cheerful travel lodging, one drunken sleep brought the morning already, and he only regretted how short the spring night was.

units.source_text: 匂皇子觉得游兴未餍，不肯就此返京。

en.t: Prince Niou felt that his pleasure in the outing was still unsatisfied, and would not return to the capital just yet.
